items.description: Venn Diagrams tool: add a split view. One side keeps the current interactive Venn diagram exactly as it works today. The other (mirrored) side shows, for each region of the Venn diagram, only the composite number formed by multiplying together the prime factors that region currently contains (i.e., the product of the primes assigned to that region). The text labels underneath the Venn diagram are shared/unaffected by this split — they are NOT duplicated or mirrored, only the interactive Venn visualization itself is split into two side-by-side views.

Rename the tool "Completing The Square" to "Fermat's Method" everywhere — directory name, file name, page title, headings, nav links, homepage card, cross-links from other tools, and any internal identifiers/labels that reference it by name.
Rename the tool "Congruence Wheel" to "Equivalence Wheel" everywhere — same scope as above (directory, file, titles, headings, nav links, homepage card, cross-links, internal labels).

Reorder the site menubar/nav (and homepage card grid, if it has its own ordering) to this exact order: Home, Sieve of Eratosthenes, Factor Tree, Venn Diagrams, Euclidean Algorithm, Congruence Wheel (i.e. the newly-renamed Equivalence Wheel), Cayley Table, Square and Multiply, Diffie-Hellman, RSA, Fermat's Method (the newly-renamed Completing The Square), Shor's Algorithm. Note: this reorder task DEPENDS ON tasks 2 and 3 (the renames) already being applied — the order above is stated with old names for clarity about which tool goes where, but by the time this task runs, "Congruence Wheel" should already be "Equivalence Wheel" and "Completing The Square" should already be "Fermat's Method". If "Shor's Algorithm", "Square and Multiply", and/or "Diffie-Hellman" tools do not exist in this repo, skip ordering entries for tools that don't exist and preserve the relative order of the ones that do, without failing the task.
